add.issue.comment.md: Picking this up as zai/milo. Plan: small bash helper identity/workspace-id.sh — canonicalize checkout via git rev-parse --show-toplevel + pwd -P (symlink aliases collapse), derive repo-group id from the resolved --git-common-dir, workspace id as hestia-<label>-<hash12> (sha256 of canonical path, first 12 hex; label = sanitized bounded basename). Optional --state-dir records/verifies the full canonical path so mismatch or collision fails before reuse. Encoding/truncation documented in identity/README.md and covered by tests/workspace-id.test.sh built on throwaway temp repos (same-basename paths, worktree vs main, branch switch, symlink alias, forged record, moved checkout).

add.issue.comment.md:
Solution: Implemented in PR #2 (commit d66a3d0 on main, rebase-merged). identity/workspace-id.sh canonicalizes a checkout (git show-toplevel + pwd -P, symlink aliases collapse incl. macOS /var vs /private/var) and prints canonical/repo-group/workspace. Workspace id hestia-<label>-<hash12> from the canonical path; repo-group from the resolved --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir (needs git >= 2.31; host has 2.55) so main checkout and linked worktrees share the group with distinct workspace ids. Label: lowercased ASCII [a-z0-9-], runs collapsed, bounded to 24 chars, fallback "repo"; hash: first 12 hex of sha256 over the UTF-8 path; total <= 44 chars matching Compose project-name rules (verified against docs.docker.com). Optional --state-dir records the full canonical path + ids; later runs fail before reuse on path mismatch ("refusing to reuse") or id collision, never rewriting old state.

Verified 2026-09-09 on macOS 25.6.0 arm64, git 2.55.0: tests/workspace-id.test.sh passed 16/16 (form/bounds, sanitization + truncation, same-basename distinct paths, worktree vs main, branch-switch stability, symlink alias, non-git/missing-path failures, record write/reuse, moved-checkout rejection with record intact, forged-record collision). CodeRabbit passed; its only flag was advisory docstring-coverage heuristics for bash. JP73P2D and 24GJSHY can consume this helper.
